statements: create policy "signatures owner read" on storage.objects for select to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'business-signatures' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text)
create policy "signatures owner insert" on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check (bucket_id = 'business-signatures' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text)

create policy "signatures owner update" on storage.objects for update to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'business-signatures' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text) with check (bucket_id = 'business-signatures' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text)
create policy "signatures owner delete" on storage.objects for delete to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'business-signatures' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text)
create policy "signatures never anonymous" on storage.objects as restrictive for all to public using (bucket_id <> 'business-signatures' or auth.uid() is not null)
rollback: drop policy "signatures owner read" on storage.objects;
drop policy "signatures owner insert" on storage.objects;
drop policy "signatures owner update" on storage.objects;
drop policy "signatures owner delete" on storage.objects;
drop policy "signatures never anonymous" on storage.objects;
delete from storage.buckets where id = 'business-signatures';  -- only while empty
